summary: Add alert-scoped free-form tags with persistence, assignment/removal endpoints, optional tag filtering, and tag projection in alert responses.
constraints: Keep the change in the existing controller -> service -> repository -> EF Core slice.
Use DataAnnotations and shared constants for request validation to match current DTO patterns.
Enforce 1-30 characters per tag, maximum 10 tags per alert, and case-insensitive deduplication.
DELETE must return 404 when the alert does not exist or the specified tag is not assigned to that alert.
GET tag filtering must compose with existing isActive, severity, createdFrom, createdTo, search, sorting, and paging behavior.
AlertResponse must include tags for reads and mutation responses.
Add an EF migration and snapshot update for SQL Server / EF Core 8.
No checked-in OpenAPI file exists; controller signatures and annotations remain the in-repo API contract source.
coverage_goals: Controller coverage for add/remove tag endpoints and GET tag query binding.
Service coverage for normalization, case-insensitive deduplication, 10-tag cap, and missing-alert or missing-assignment behavior.
Repository coverage for tag persistence and composable tag filtering with existing filters.
implementation_assumptions: POST /api/alerts/{id}/tags uses a request DTO with a tags collection property.
GET /api/alerts uses a single optional tag query parameter matched case-insensitively.
Tag comparisons are case-insensitive, input is trimmed, and response casing preserves the stored display value.
Removing the final assignment does not require orphan Tag cleanup unless implementation reveals an existing cleanup convention.
